messages:
Maya Chen: quick update — q4b-v2 pushed to canary. Initial eval on promptset-alpha shows overall drop (~6% exact-match vs fp16). suspect de-dup / longtail sampling mismatch in prompt bank. need golden refresh + relabel batch. details below.

Jon Park: numbers?

Maya Chen: here are the quick numbers:
```
model   eval_split     EM    BLEU
fp16    alpha_canary  0.78  0.64
q4b-v2  alpha_canary  0.72  0.61
delta                -0.06 -0.03
samples: 4.1k
```

Priya Patel: can we confirm this is a model-regression and not an inference config/tokenizer regression? any config diffs?

Maya Chen: no tokenizer changes. only quant kernels + packaging. infra logs show kvcache hit rate drops on long prompts (~>1k tokens) for q4b-v2.

Samir Gupta: proposal:
1) run dedupe sweep on promptset-alpha (fuzzyhash thresh 0.85)
2) seed ~500 balanced golden across intents/len strata (include edgecases)
3) relabel jobs (priority = high) with 10% double-annotate QC
4) re-run canary and eval harness
I can run dedupe + seed tomorrow morning unless objections.

Ava Lopez: labeler capacity check: we have 10 immediate slots today, ~50 tomorrow morning. prefer batching by length-strata (short/med/long). include provenance metadata (source, scrape-date, normalizer version).

Maya Chen: @LabelOpsBot please create ticket `q4b-alpha-golden-refresh` assign eng-ml + curation, priority P1.

LabelOpsBot: ticket created: INC-8421 — Title: q4b-alpha-golden-refresh. Assigned: Priya Patel. ETA: 48h.

Jon Park: also add a small int8 fallback gating run to isolate whether degradation is quantization-level vs kernel fallback.

Priya Patel: I'll pause the canary rollout until we have relabel results. Plan: start dedupe tonight, seed golden tomorrow morning, relabel completes by Wed EOD.

Samir Gupta: dedupe command I'll run: `python tools/fuzzy_dedupe.py --input promptset-alpha.jsonl --thresh 0.85 --keep-longer --out deduped-alpha.jsonl`
Pre-cleaning: `scripts/normalize_html.py --in ... --out ...` to remove entity noise that inflates duplicates.

Maya Chen: also let's carve out micro-goldens: long-context (>1024 tokens) = 200 samples, code-snippet category = 200 samples. make sure they cross-check with existing gold.

Ava Lopez: tagging plan for labelers: use labeler tag `q4b_golden_v1`. QC: double-annotate 10%, and lead-review on disagreements > 0.2 disagreement score.

Jon Park: after relabeling, run eval harness: `eval/harness/run_eval.py --model q4b-v2 --golden q4b_golden_v1 --out results/q4b_v2_alpha.csv` and post csv to #eng-ml. include per-intent and per-length breakdown.

Maya Chen: owners — Samir (dedupe + seed), Priya (ticket + pause + relabel coord), Ava (labeler ops/QC). I'll coordinate canary resume and final go/no-go.

Priya Patel: noted. I'll add the relabel job to the scheduler and ping ops if we hit capacity. ETA update tomorrow AM.

Samir Gupta: starting dedupe run in ~30m. will post artifacts + seed list to the ticket when done.

Maya Chen: perfect. thanks all. will follow up with small summary we can paste into the release notes when we either revert or roll forward. :thumbsup:
